expectations.text: Cites the Eventtia 2024 managed-conference data point - a 3 dollar refundable deposit taking a previously free event from a 38% to a 14% no-show rate - and labels it a general-conference result rather than a developer-event one.

expectations.text: Cites the 37signals/Basecamp Chicago breakfast data point - a 100 dollar deposit refunded at the door, 55 people paying it and 50 showing, a roughly 90% show rate.
expectations.evidence: "$100 deposit refunded at the door. 55 paid and 50 showed up."

expectations.text: Names the loss-aversion limit: an attendee reimbursed by an employer may not feel a deposit the way someone paying out of pocket does.
